name: Anda Paratha
description: A filling Pakistani breakfast of crisp paratha served with a seasoned egg.
method: Heat a tawa over medium heat and cook each paratha with a little ghee or oil until golden and crisp on both sides. Keep warm.
Beat the eggs with green chili, coriander, salt and black pepper.
Heat a lightly greased frying pan over medium heat and add the egg mixture.
Cook until the egg is fully set, turning or folding as preferred; avoid leaving liquid raw egg in the centre.
Serve immediately with the hot parathas and chutney or pickle if desired.
tips: Use medium heat so the paratha browns without burning.
Cook the egg until fully set for food safety.
